events.printedTarget: one other active Pokémon within the user active’s distance limit

recommendedPolicies: Do not create a normal move-defense/Dodge response for either event; neither paragraph prints one.
Jigglypuff may choose self or a distant active: no other-target or distance clause, and booklet default move range is not a universal event range.

Always conduct Jigglypuff judgment before conditional status application, even if existing status or effective Shield Dust/Vital Spirit would prevent Sleep. Empty deck supplies no judgment result and does not satisfy not-thunderstorm.
Use shared Drought judgment replacements and status pipeline: one-status rule, effective Shield Dust/Vital Spirit and Poison Touch replacement remain.
Effective active Kangaskhan Early Bird prohibits becoming the target of these two named events; Gas can suppress that protection. It is not a general event immunity.

Mr. Mime uses user active distance for another active, including legitimate range effects that apply to the event/card. Do not inherit command-only or explicitly move-only range changes without their wording.

Mr. Mime obtains one actual hidden hand card OR one actual held item; it neither reveals the whole hand nor discards/equips the selected card. Preserve ID, weather and metadata through shared gain/Pickup and held-item-loss hooks.
Offer a Mr. Mime alternative only when it has a real card to obtain; target should have hand or item. This legality policy avoids fictional cards and is not an extra printed prerequisite.
Capture original active target and consume one physical event once; strict authority/retry/reconnect/vote contracts and hidden information remain server-owned.
No per-card copy quantities or weather distribution inferred from stacked cards or observed variants.
